The manifest.json file defines the extension: { "name" : "Gitea Issue Preview" , "description" : "An extension built for previewing gitea issues!" , "version" : "1.0" , "key" : "" , "manifest_version" : 2 , "content_scripts" : [ { "matches" : [ "*://*/*/issues" ], "js" : [ "inject.js" ] } ], "permissions" : [ "identity" , "storage" , "activeTab" , "scripting" ], "content_security_policy" : "script-src 'self'; object-src 'self';" }
